title: Hybrid Quantum Selection of Learning Rates in Language-Model Training: Termination Criteria and an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle
abstract: arXiv:2611.21701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning-rate choices strongly affect language-model fine-tuning, but the best joint profile across layer groups is generally unknown. This paper studies quantum minimum finding for layer-group learning-rate selection within a hybrid classical-quantum training framework. It combines Durr-Hoyer minimum finding with BBHT search and compares fixed-budget and confidence-based stopping policies using a lookup oracle built from measured profile scores at fixed training checkpoints. The paper then introduces an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle that scores and marks joint schedules in superposition without a precomputed score table. Classical one-step loss measurements supply the main, pairwise and three-way interaction effects between layer groups. translated_title: 语言模型训练中学习率的混合量子选择：终止准则与交互引导的调度预言机
translated_abstract: 学习率的选择对语言模型微调效果影响很大，但跨层组的最佳联合学习率配置通常是未知的。本文研究在经典-量子混合训练框架中，利用量子最小值查找算法进行层组学习率选择。该方法将Dürr-Høyer最小值查找与BBHT搜索相结合，并使用基于固定训练检查点处测得的配置分数构建的查找预言机，比较了固定预算和基于置信度两种停止策略。论文随后提出了一种交互引导的调度预言机，该预言机无需预先计算的分数表，即可在叠加态中对联合调度进行评分和标记。经典的一步损失测量提供了层组之间的主效应、两两交互效应和三阶交互效应。量子电路为每个调度累加这些效应，将所得分数与当前基线分数进行比较，并标记出有改进的调度以供振幅放大使用。测量得到的候选配置经过验证……
tldr: 本文提出一种经典-量子混合训练框架，结合Dürr-Høyer最小值查找与BBHT搜索来选择层组学习率，并创新性地引入无需预计算分数表的交互引导调度预言机，通过叠加态评分与振幅放大高效寻找语言模型微调的最佳联合学习率配置。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid classical-quantum framework for selecting layer-group learning rates by combining Dürr-Høyer minimum finding with BBHT search, and introduces an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle that scores joint schedules in superposition without a precomputed score table, enabling efficient identification of optimal learning-rate profiles for language-model fine-tuning.
